semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Conformal prediction is a statistical technique that can be applied to any predictive modeling task to quantify the uncertainty in predictions. Thus, it is considered as part of predictive modeling approaches.

parent_domains.justification: Conformal prediction is grounded in the theory of machine learning, providing a theoretical framework for making predictions with confidence intervals, hence it falls under theoretical machine learning.
Since conformal prediction is used to enhance predictive modeling tasks by providing a measure of confidence, it is considered a part of the broader field of predictive modeling.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Among the parent domains, predictive modeling is the closest because conformal prediction specifically pertains to providing confidence measures in predictive models.

child_domains.justification: Self-prediction could be seen as a specific application area where conformal prediction might be used to add confidence measures.

closest_child_domain.justification: Self-prediction is a specific domain where conformal prediction can directly enhance the prediction process by adding confidence measures, making it the closest child domain.

sibling_domains.justification: n-body dynamics prediction shares the same closest parent domain of predictive modeling and focuses on predictions within a physical system.
Behavioral prediction is also related to predictive modeling, specifically focusing on predicting behaviors.
Sequence prediction involves predicting the next elements in a series, which is a type of predictive modeling.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Behavioral prediction is semantically close to conformal prediction since both are focused on predicting outcomes with a degree of uncertainty which conformal prediction addresses directly.

unrelated_domains.justification: Protein structure prediction is a specialized domain in bioinformatics unrelated to conformal prediction.
Protein function prediction, like structure prediction, is specialized for biological tasks not directly connected to conformal prediction.
This domain applies machine learning within astrophysics and is not aligned with the focus of conformal prediction.
Molecular property prediction is a specific scientific application area not directly aligned with the theoretical focus of conformal prediction.
While temporal predictions involve prediction over time, they do not specifically relate to the methodology of conformal prediction.
